title_en: Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models
title_zh: 基于流匹配的具身基础模型两阶段后训练框架
summary_en: The paper proposes a two-stage post-training framework for flow-based embodied foundation models, building distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 consolidates expert capabilities via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Stage 2 combines reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher distillation that weights velocity errors according to sampling noise, restricting distillation to failed trajectories to provide dense guidance without constraining successful behaviors. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show the framework outperforms joint SFT and exceeds the aggregate success rates of corresponding teachers, achieving higher success rates than direct RL with fewer environment interactions.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于流匹配的具身基础模型两阶段后训练框架，从条件流匹配的速度回归形式构建蒸馏目标。第一阶段通过多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）高效整合专家能力。第二阶段将强化学习（RL）与教师蒸馏结合，根据采样噪声对速度误差加权，且蒸馏仅限制在失败轨迹上，以密集指导补充稀疏奖励而不直接约束成功行为。在多个模型和基准上的实验表明，该框架优于联合SFT，并超过相应教师的总体成功率；样本效率比较显示，与直接RL相比，在更少的环境交互下获得更高的成功率。
content_en: Large-scale pretraining provides embodied models with general capabilities, but reliable task execution still requires post training. In multitask settings, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) faces distribution mismatch between training and deployment, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) is limited by sparse rewards and uneven learning progress across tasks. Multi-teacher on policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates expert capabilities through dense supervision on the model's own trajectories, but achieving performance beyond the teachers remains challenging. We propose a two-stage post training framework for flow-based embodied models, constructing distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities through MOPD. Stage 2 combines RL with teacher distillation that weights velocity errors according to the sampling noise, where distillation is restricted to failed trajectories to supplement sparse rewards with dense guidance without directly constraining successful behaviors. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that the framework outperforms joint SFT and exceeds the corresponding teachers' aggregate success rates. Sample efficiency comparisons show higher success rates than direct RL with fewer environment interactions.
content_zh: 大规模预训练为具身模型提供了通用能力，但可靠的任务执行仍需后训练。在多任务场景下，监督微调（SFT）面临训练与部署之间的分布失配问题，而强化学习（RL）则受限于稀疏奖励以及各任务间学习进度不均衡。多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）通过对模型自身轨迹的稠密监督来整合专家能力，但实现超越教师模型的性能仍具挑战性。我们提出一种面向基于流的具身模型的两阶段后训练框架，从条件流匹配的速度回归公式出发构建蒸馏目标。阶段1通过MOPD高效整合专家能力。阶段2将RL与教师蒸馏相结合，根据采样噪声对速度误差进行加权，其中蒸馏仅限制在失败轨迹上，以稠密引导补充稀疏奖励，而不直接约束成功行为。在多个模型和基准上的实验表明，该框架优于联合SFT，并超过相应教师模型的总体成功率。样本效率比较显示，在更少的环境交互下即可获得比直接RL更高的成功率。
